source.title: Fantasy Football 'Do Not Draft' list: Giants' young trio among players being overvalued
source.author: Eric Karabell
source.summary: Karabell fades prominent players whose ADP assumes health, volume, efficiency, or immediate rookie impact that he does not trust.
